sentinelValues.meaning: the last item added to menu

overloads.semanticRole: Get the additional modifier key(s) (Shift and/or Option/Alt) combined with a menu item's standard shortcut key.

constraints: If menu is a MenuRef (menu reference), the process parameter is unnecessary and is ignored if passed.

The additional modifiers (Shift = 512, Option/Alt = 2048, summed if both apply) can only be set/reported when a standard shortcut has already been assigned via SET MENU ITEM SHORTCUT; returns 0 if the item has no associated modifier key.
